hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: get_file_from_s3
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: check this if you want to pull the full conceptstoremove file from s3 rather than upload direct

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
api='http://dictionaryetl:8086/api'
cleanup() { unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN } trap cleanup EXIT
assume_role() { local role_arn="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" local session_name="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" local duration="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
log "Assuming role ${role_arn} (duration=${duration}s)" local assume_json assume_json="$(mktemp)"
aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$duration" \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "$session_name" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")"
rm -f "$assume_json" log "Role assumed" }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
log "Validating prerequisites" need aws need jq need csvcut need curl log "Prerequisites OK"
# ----------------------------------- # Optionally refresh files from S3 # ----------------------------------- if [[ -n "${get_file_from_s3:-}" ]]; then assume_role
log "Downloading concepts lists from S3" aws s3 cp "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/data/conceptsToRemove.txt" ./conceptsToRemove.txt --no-progress aws s3 cp "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/data/approved_concepts.txt" ./approved_concepts.txt --no-progress
cleanup fi
# ----------------------------------- # Upload stigvars lists to Dictionary ETL API # ----------------------------------- log "Preparing stigvars=true list from conceptsToRemove.txt (col 1)" csvcut -c 1 conceptsToRemove.txt > stigvars.txt
log "PUT ${api}/concept/metadata/stigvars?value=true (bytes=$(wc -c < stigvars.txt))" curl --fail --retry 5 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 0 \ --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-binary @stigvars.txt \ "${api}/concept/metadata/stigvars?value=true" \ > /dev/null log "stigvars=true update complete"
log "Preparing stigvars=false list from approved_concepts.txt (col 1)" csvcut -c 1 approved_concepts.txt > nonstigvars.txt
log "PUT ${api}/concept/metadata/stigvars?value=false (bytes=$(wc -c < nonstigvars.txt))" curl --fail --retry 5 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 0 \ --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-binary @nonstigvars.txt \ "${api}/concept/metadata/stigvars?value=false" \ > /dev/null log "stigvars=false update complete"
log "Done"
